title: JAFN country record
description: One EU member state's legal-data record. Every legal fact is a Fact<T> envelope: a value cannot exist without the source and date that justify it. Unknown is value:null with status:"pending_verification" — never a guess. Cross-field invariants (launch-country verified_by, Art. 12(3) as a condition, the Directive fallback citation rule) are enforced by CI, not by this file.
